title: StarRating does not indicates non relevant refinements
body:
When using `<Configure filters="rating>2"/>` along with StarRating widget, ratings 1 and 2 should be disabled but they are not.

It seems to be triggered because we are not using the stats while constructing the StarRating widget.

Either we should implement it with ConnectMultiRange or we should forward stats from connectRange.

Cc @mthuret
